title: Paint Lab v0.1.28 — Continuous Pencil Rendering
changes: Replace the normal Pencil dab-stamp path with a dedicated continuous quadratic-curve graphite stroke; remove periodic gaps and circular translucent footprints, including at large canvas zoom.
Make the Pencil contact patch much narrower than a paint brush and constrain pressure-driven width changes; pencil hardness now controls edge softness and pigment density.
Use the chosen pencil colour throughout the stroke, including palette colour travel; render single taps as small solid lead contacts rather than huge round brush stamps.
Preserve historical appearance for previously saved strokes: new strokes record pencilEngine=continuous-v1 in editable history; legacy strokes keep their original replay engine.
Verify connected rendering across dense and sparse pointer samples at full-opacity hard pencil and softer coloured pencil settings; check browser JavaScript and release checksums.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.27 — Velocity-Sensitive Oil Brush Lift
changes: Replace the separate artificial round endpoint and simple tangent-based cutoff with a path-aware final contact model using actual stroke motion and original paint underlay.
Estimate end-of-stroke deceleration from recorded pointer positions and event timestamps: slower releases produce longer, narrower tails, while quick releases remain more abrupt.

Account for Apple Pencil end pressure and brush-tip family: pointed brushes and liners taper to thin ends; round, filbert and mop taper moderately; flat, bright and chisel shapes retain relatively abrupt ends; fans, rakes and combs keep separated hairs.
Keep loaded bristle pigment, grain and existing layers stable at the endpoint; taper the already-painted contact area without stamping a translucent disc or creating a second visible brush mark.
Bound final-contact readback and processing cost for mobile use, with deterministic replay and browser pixel checks comparing fast/slow round, flat, liner and fan releases.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.26 — Reliable Mobile Touch & Oil Brush Ends
changes: Prevent mobile canvas gestures from retaining stale touch IDs after pointer cancellation, lost capture, backgrounding, or window blur; require two live contacts for pinch and rotation.
Block remaining fingers from painting or rotating after a multi-touch gesture until all fingers have lifted, then restore immediate single-contact drawing.
Use a short provisional touch grace period and per-stroke pixel rollback tiles so a late second finger cancels accidental paint without replaying the full project history.
Selecting a pigment or brush tip now exits any leftover layer-transform state so drawing cannot accidentally manipulate a layer pivot.
Make the chosen palette swatch and brush tip visibly selected, with contrast-safe insets, checkmarks, and aria-pressed states.

Replace zero-length oil bristle fanning, damp sudden tip-angle changes, and round solid-tip stroke endpoints without flattening the interior bristle relief; preserve separated comb, rake and fan endings.
Add targeted regression tests for gesture lock release, touch rollback, oil stroke finish and active UI selection.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.25 — Functional Smear, Smudge & Blend
changes: Replace the old retouch implementation that re-stamped copied pixels with movement-driven Smear, colour-mixing Smudge and position-preserving Blend operations. These tools sample visible painted layers, not the currently selected pigment.
Smear transports paint in the pointer direction and carries a bounded brush pickup; Smudge moves and softens neighbouring pigment; Blend softens transitions without directional dragging.
Support retouch sampling from lower visible layers even when the active paint layer is transparent, while modifying only the active layer.
Prevent accidental retouch dabs when the user only taps the canvas; retouch starts with pointer movement and all operations retain editable stroke history.
Clicking the Paint tab or its tool-rail shortcut after using Effects restores Normal Brush; selecting Pencil, Chalk, Watercolour or Oil also resets the current retouch mode.
Use willReadFrequently for the cached material stamp that stylization reads, avoiding repeat Canvas2D GPU readback advisory warnings.
Move focus outside the Studio Settings drawer before hiding it and set inert to prevent blocked aria-hidden focus warnings.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.24 — Server Test Dependency Fix
changes: Remove the undeclared Pillow/PIL dependency from the public-sharing server integration test: generate a valid RGBA PNG fixture with Python standard-library struct and zlib.
Keep public image publication and owner-isolation/revocation tests mandatory during Ubuntu deployment; no runtime Pillow dependency is needed.
Exclude transient Python test caches from checksum-verified release ZIPs and rebuild manifest.json with the project release builder.
Retain all v0.1.23 canvas sizes, share/export functionality, palette XL/M/S and colour-travel painting without changes.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.23 — Portable Artworks, Canvas Presets & Sharing
changes: Add a New Canvas dialog with Window size, 1:1, 3:2, 2:3, 16:9, 3:4, 4:3 and 2:1 aspect ratios, plus explicit custom dimensions up to 8192px per side and a 16MP memory safeguard.
New canvases accept an optional name; use it to prefill the Save Artwork name, while unnamed works preserve the empty name field and Untitled fallback.
Add Save dialog shortcuts for PNG with paper, transparent PNG, and a portable ZIP project preserving editable history, layer PNGs, user brush assets, and a preview.
Import portable ZIP projects offline and restore visible layer pixels directly, retaining editable history for undo/redo and legacy JSON imports.
Add native Web Share API support using the supplied share SVG and a PNG download fallback when file sharing is unavailable.
Introduce explicitly opt-in authenticated public image publishing, revocable share links, and a public /u/username gallery. Private cloud projects and API credentials remain private.
Document the ZIP format, import limits, cloud sharing controls, and release compatibility.
Add palette XL/M/S swatch presets displaying 8, 24, or 48 colours; preserve the source palette across size switches and interpolate additional colours in OKLab.

Add compact movement-driven Palette Flow switch beside the harmony selector: pigment advances through swatches by brush distance (not elapsed time), including oil-bristle refill and text stamps. Store the exact palette in each editable stroke and remember size/flow in projects and presets.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.22 — Pointer-anchored Desktop Transforms & Verified Release Packaging
changes: Make desktop G, R, S, and Shift+D transforms confirm with a single left click (Enter also confirms), and cancel with right-click or Escape without a click-and-drag.

Anchor the transform to the last desktop mouse position in canvas document coordinates; preserve the original grab offset at arbitrary zoom and canvas rotation instead of jumping to the layer-centre pivot.
If no mouse position is available when the keyboard shortcut is pressed, establish it on first movement without displacing the artwork.
Correct the release process: build the ZIP through tools/build_release.py to include the required manifest.json, SHA256 checksums, and bundled watcher for the existing deployment pipeline.
Retain v0.1.21 pencil, text-brush and appearance controls and restore historical development-log entries.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.21 — Live Chrome Preview, Truer Pencil & Character Brush
changes: Keep the workspace readable while adjusting window appearance: the settings shade no longer blurs the whole studio, so border, opacity and blur changes are visible live.
Propagate window-border visibility more broadly across the interface, including buttons, fields, swatches, layer rows, thumbnails and other chrome elements instead of only panel shells.
Rework pencil rendering to respect the chosen colour much more faithfully, with harder pencils producing crisper edges, fuller saturation and a thinner, steadier line.
Add Pencil behaviour controls for hardness and diameter dynamics, so pencil strokes stay much less width-reactive than paint brushes.
Add a Character & Text Brush section in Brush Tips: type a character, word or short sentence to create a reusable stamp tip, or enable live text stamping along the stroke path.
Support letter-by-letter brush writing with iOS-style pill toggles, spacing control, fixed-angle or path-following orientation, and optional rotation jitter.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.20 — Clean Canvas Reset & Oil Colour Integrity
changes: Clear Canvas now removes the old layer stack and starts with exactly one transparent Background paint layer; Undo restores the complete previous multi-layer composition and Redo clears again.
Keep earlier projects compatible: historical Clear actions retain their original layer-preserving meaning; new resets carry an explicit resetLayers history marker.
Speed up reconstruction of a cleared drawing by skipping all strokes and layer changes before the latest full reset while keeping the editable Undo history.
Correct oil-paint contamination: cache the original paint beneath each stroke in bounded tiles, so a brush never picks up its own shaded relief pixels as dark pigment.
Limit wet-colour uptake and separate surface lighting from pigment mixing so white and pale oil remain clean on unpainted canvas while still mixing with genuine existing paint.
Add browser and regression checks for layer reset, undo/redo, saved-project recovery and white oil strokes.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.19 — Recovery Safety & Fast Resume
changes: Fix stale recovery replay painting over a cleared or replaced canvas. Clear, New, Undo and project switching invalidate in-flight restoration before pixels can be applied.
Cache full-fidelity layer pixel snapshots alongside matching IndexedDB recovery history, so subsequent restarts restore the current image without replaying hundreds of strokes.
Use cancellable, responsive legacy-history replay with a Stop restoring control. Preserve a recovery backup in Gallery before skipping a long restore.
Skip paint actions made before the most recent Clear during rebuilding, without discarding history needed for Undo or saved projects.
Throttle startup console progress logs, and fix cropping of the animated Paint Lab title.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.18 — Denser Oil Pigment & Startup Polish
changes: Make loaded oil brushes lay down a contiguous, substantially more opaque paint body rather than evenly spaced semi-transparent strands; preserve intentionally separated rake, comb and stipple tips.
Improve bristle spacing and stroke sampling while retaining directional ridge highlights, per-strand colour pickup and paint-load controls.
Show the deployed version directly in the browser tab title.
Display a brief pastel-gradient Paint Lab title after release notes are dismissed, or on refresh when notes have already been read; the animation never blocks painting.
Open Save New with an empty name field and save an unnamed artwork as Untitled.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.17 — Multi-select & Merge Layers
changes: Select layers like Finder: Shift-click for a continuous range and Command/Ctrl-click for non-adjacent layers; thumbnails also support modified selection without losing drag-to-reorder.
Duplicate, delete, and toggle visibility for multiple selected layers in a single undoable history step.

Merge selected layers or all layers into a single raster layer at document pixel resolution, retaining visible opacity and blend results; confirm hidden and non-adjacent merge caveats before proceeding.
Show the supplied closed-eye SVG when a layer is hidden, and the existing eye icon when visible.
Preserve grouped layer actions through editable project JSON, autosave, redo/undo, and release notes.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.16 — Reliable Brush Tips & Server Diagnostics
changes: Fix oil brush-tip fidelity: round, liner, flat, fan, rake, mop, sword and imported brush shapes now drive actual bristle contacts and stroke widths instead of identical uniform oil ribbons.
Make development release notes display immediately from packaged data; fetch the server changelog in the background with a short timeout.
Restore recent browser artwork incrementally with progress and no redundant full synchronous replay; expose client startup timings.
Add an authenticated administrator-only application log terminal with adjustable font size, pause/resume, refresh and copy; log request duration and errors without request bodies or provider secrets.
Add a server-shell administrator-provisioning CLI and backwards-compatible SQLite user role migration, without any default administrator passwords.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.15 — Adjustable Window Chrome & Natural Stroke Widening
changes: Add window-border visibility, panel background transparency, shadow enable/strength and backdrop blur controls in Appearance; settings persist in named presets.
Add a natural stroke width toggle, initial brush-tip contact, widening distance, and velocity response in Brush & Paint → Dynamics.
Apply reproducible distance-based widening to the oil contact engine and all other painted stroke materials while retaining pressure sensitivity and existing project compatibility.
Preserve independent brush-tip shape response and stored brush settings in each history action.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.14 — Stylized Strokes & Wet Oil Brush
changes: Add six independent stylized painting modes: Halftone, ASCII, Invert, Pixelate, Mosaic and Symbols; each stroke remembers its selected style.

Introduce an oil brush contact model with independent pigment reservoirs across bristles, pickup of wet underlying colour, pressure- and viscosity-controlled deposition, and directional ridge shading.
Replace 24 individual Canvas2D preview renderers in Brush Tips with one cached shared thumbnail atlas; category switches reuse the atlas and custom brush imports rebuild it once.
Reuse one inversion mask canvas across stylized dabs instead of allocating new 2D canvases during painting.
Retain imported brush tips, layer history, undo/redo, project JSON and mobile controls; this is a local wet-pigment approximation, not a Navier–Stokes fluid solver.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.13 — Distinct Pigment Brush Engines
changes: Replace the shared pencil/chalk/watercolour/oil tip-fill algorithm with four distinct procedural pigment textures: narrow grainy graphite, broken powdery chalk, translucent pooled watercolour, and opaque directional oil bristle relief.
Preserve each chosen artistic tip, including imported alpha PNG tips, while varying actual mark coverage, alpha, edge diffusion, grain and highlight/shadow by pigment material.
Cache pre-rasterized pigment/tip/colour stamp textures to keep live strokes responsive on tablets; use deterministic noise to reproduce strokes after undo/redo and editable-project reload.
Add a renderer regression contract and browser pixel-comparison QA to verify that pigment modes create materially different traces.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.12 — Immediate Desktop Transforms & Shift+D
changes: Desktop G, R, and S now move, rotate, and scale the selected shape or active layer immediately with mouse movement; no click-and-drag is required.
Press Shift+D to duplicate the selected shape or active layer and position the provisional copy with the mouse; left-click or Enter confirms, Esc or right-click cancels without creating a duplicate.
Duplication and transformation are recorded as single editable history actions, preserving undo/redo, native pixel dimensions, and project save/reopen at any zoom.
Update the keyboard-help overlay and documentation to explain the desktop confirm/cancel workflow; keep touch gestures and contextual mobile tools unchanged.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.11 — Mobile Gesture Performance & Contextual Transforms
changes: Fix mobile pinch/pan/rotation freezing by separating the static document paint texture from viewport transforms; gestures no longer recompose every layer or reupload the painted texture.
Reduce gesture-frame shader work and skip unnecessary palette DOM reconstruction, brush-preview updates and selection redraw during navigation; restore full-quality paper when navigation ends.
Do not replay the entire painting history when a second finger starts a gesture during a stroke; commit the in-progress stroke safely.
Hide the mobile Move/Rotate/Scale buttons outside an active transform. Activate transforms through the Layers tool sheet, then use the contextual right-side controls.
Retain independent two-finger canvas navigation when no artwork transform is selected, and keep existing desktop shortcuts, project data and layers intact.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.10 — View-Safe Layer Transforms & Mobile Canvas Rotation
changes: Fix layer duplication scaling at zoom levels other than 100% and on high-DPI displays by copying the native pixel buffer without an inherited DPR transform.
Add document-coordinate Move (G), Rotate (R) and Scale (S) manipulation to the active layer; transformations use a live preview and join Undo/Redo and editable project history.
Apply the same move, rotation and scale gestures to a selected vector shape instead of the entire layer.
Expose three compact, independent mobile transform buttons on the right side, and route two-finger rotate/pinch/pan gestures to the object only when a transform mode is selected.
Restore canvas rotation as a default mobile gesture, migrate previous disabled defaults once, and accumulate angular changes without wraparound jumps.
Keep normal two-finger canvas zoom, pan and rotation isolated from layer transforms and provide Escape to leave transform modes.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.9 — Mobile Brush Controls & Stable Gestures
changes: Place Undo and Redo together at the bottom right of the mobile canvas, visible by default with history-aware disabled states and a workspace toggle.
Move the current brush-tip preview above the colour swatch, reflecting the selected artistic tip rather than showing a fixed pencil.
Replace the unreliable mobile vertical native range input with a wide, pointer-captured touch slider, live brush size readout, and keyboard accessibility.

Prevent sudden pinch zoom and accidental canvas tilt by tracking a stable touch pair, using canvas-relative coordinates, and defaulting mobile rotation to off while retaining an opt-in rotation setting.
Make Account / Profile entry visible in mobile settings and tool navigation, with direct access to account creation, sign-in and private cloud canvases.
Provide Fit and straighten canvas in mobile settings to recover a tilted or off-centre document.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.8 — Safe Canvas Clearing
changes: Add a trash-can action to the desktop toolbar, mobile painting controls and History panel.
Use a custom three-choice dialog: No, Yes—clear, or Save before clearing; never a browser-native confirmation.
Save before clearing creates a named copy in the local gallery and clears only after its IndexedDB write succeeds; cancellation or failure leaves the artwork intact.
Clear paint from every layer while keeping layer structure, paper and canvas dimensions; Undo and Redo restore the operation.
Make Clear canvas optionally visible on the mobile toolbar, enabled by default, while retaining the paint-only focus mode.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.7 — Mobile Canvas-First Studio
changes: Introduce a dedicated mobile painting workspace with an edge-to-edge canvas and one-tap focus mode that hides every control except the upper-left toggle.
Add a minimal bottom-left colour swatch with an edge-anchored scrolling palette, palette-cycle control and native custom-colour picker.
Add compact brush-tip cycling, a vertical diameter slider, pigment cycling and optional eraser, undo and painting status controls.
Move mobile canvas preferences and access to the full brush, effects, shapes, layers, paper, gallery and export tools into a touch-friendly Settings drawer and tool sheets.
Remember mobile control visibility and focus preferences independently from the desktop floating-panel workspace.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.6 — Document View & Compact Brush Workspace
changes: Canvas zoom, pan and rotation now redraw painted layers immediately rather than waiting for the next brush stroke.
A clear rotated document boundary separates the paper surface from a grey-and-white checkerboard outside the canvas.
Collapsed Palette windows display selectable colour swatches within a smaller header; Fit and Collapse controls share consistent compact dimensions.
Brush tip gallery adapts the number of columns and preview sizes to the available space, showing more tips and scrolling less.
Cloud sign-in and AI provider key fields are associated with forms to eliminate Chrome DOM password input warnings.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.5 — Adaptive Palette & Colour Transformations
changes: Replace the redundant 25th palette tile with the native colour picker as the first of 24 swatches, eliminating the orphan final row.
Automatically reflow the entire colour grid to complete rows as the floating palette is resized, including very wide, short layouts.
Make Gradients blend the selected first colour through optional Shift-selected stops to the final swatch using perceptual OKLab interpolation.
Make Pastels, Sharp, Chromatics and Sepias transform existing colours rather than replace the palette; add Warm, Cool, Earth, Neon, Muted, Vintage, Monochrome and Invert modifiers.
Use the supplied distinct SVG designs for Fit panel and Collapse panel controls.

history.title: Paint Lab v0.1.4 — What’s New & Development Log
changes: Add a What’s New overlay after each new release, with a Latest tab and searchable-by-version history list.
Remember which release notes were dismissed on each browser, and reopen them any time from the toolbar.
Publish the same release history to the public application and the GitHub repository.
Add project README, ABOUT and CHANGELOG documents with development, deployment, API and future roadmap context.
Extend the ZIP watcher with verified, guarded synchronization of GitHub-root documentation.

history.title: Fast painting workflow and reusable brush tips
changes: One-tap Pencil, Chalk, Watercolour and Oil on the draggable tool rail, plus an always-visible painting status strip.
Compact colour-first palette, procedural and imported image brush tips, and brush tip categories.
Faster layer add, clone, delete and reorder; paged stroke history without losing editable actions.

history.title: SVG icon library and desktop shortcuts
changes: Replace many text-based action symbols with theme-aware SVG icons supplied for the application.
Fix Command+/ and Ctrl+/ to display the keyboard shortcuts help overlay.

history.title: Coloured watcher and safer TLS bootstrap
changes: Improve watcher output with distinct coloured deployment start, success, warning and failure banners.
Reuse existing Let’s Encrypt Certbot accounts where available when issuing the Paint Lab certificate.

history.title: First versioned Paint Lab service
changes: Package the browser painting studio with brush materials, procedural tips, canvas layers and IndexedDB gallery.
Add Flask, authenticated SQLite canvases, WebSocket notifications and an encrypted AI API-key vault.
Introduce an isolated Ubuntu nginx/systemd deployment and SHA-256 verified ZIP release watcher.
